title: What Are the Best AI Pentest Tools in the Netherlands? [October 2026]
summary: Compare the best AI pentest tools in the Netherlands for 2026: MindFort, XBOW, Pentera, Horizon3.ai, Hadrian, RunSybil, PentAGI, and Dutch pentest firms.
body_markdown:
This guide explains why Dutch companies are under pressure to run more pentests in 2026. It compares seven AI pentest tools with two leading Dutch pentest companies. It also covers the Cyberbeveiligingswet, DORA, and pentest costs.


## Why do Dutch companies need pentests now?


The[Cyberbeveiligingswet ↗](https://www.rijksoverheid.nl/actueel/nieuws/2026/08/15/cyberbeveiligingswet-en-wet-weerbaarheid-kritieke-entiteiten-vanaf-vandaag-van-kracht) (Cbw) is the Dutch NIS2 law, and it took effect on August 15, 2026. It applies to thousands of organisations across 18 sectors. Essential entities face fines of up to[€10 million or 2% of worldwide turnover ↗](https://zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl/kst-36764-2.html) . Board members must approve the security measures and oversee them.


## Does the Cyberbeveiligingswet require a pentest?


Not explicitly. Article 18 of the[Cyberbeveiligingsbesluit ↗](https://zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl/stb-2026-189.html) requires entities to evaluate the effectiveness of their security measures periodically. For digital providers, EU Implementing Regulation 2024/2690 adds a[security testing policy based on risk ↗](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2024/2690/oj) . A pentest is the most common way to show that evidence to a supervisor.


## What do DORA, TIBER-NL, and BIO2 expect?


- **DORA:** the[regulation ↗](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2022/2554/oj) requires financial entities to test critical ICT systems at least yearly, and designated entities must run threat-led pentests at least every three years.
- **TIBER-NL:** DNB says[some testing became mandatory from 2025 ↗](https://www.dnb.nl/en/sector-information/cash-and-payment-systems/dnb-oversees-cyber-resilience-tests/) through DORA's threat-led testing.
- **BIO2:** the government security baseline[became legally binding for government bodies ↗](https://www.bio-overheid.nl/nieuws/cyberbeveiligingswet-in-werking-bio2-wettelijk-verankerd/) when the Cyberbeveiligingswet took effect.

### 1. What is MindFort best for?


MindFort deploys autonomous AI agents that run black-box and white-box tests on your apps continuously. It's the fastest tool on this list to get started: run a test today and get findings in hours without a sales call. Every finding ships with proof of exploit, a pull request with a validated fix, and a retest. MindFort is a newer company with less funding than XBOW or Pentera.


### 2. What is XBOW best for?


XBOW runs autonomous pentests against[web applications and their APIs ↗](https://docs.xbow.com/console/reference/asset-types) reachable from the public internet. It offers[EU data residency in AWS Frankfurt ↗](https://xbow.com/blog/xbow-available-eu-data-residency) as a private preview for Enterprise customers. Its[AWS Marketplace listing ↗](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-aj7ajvgepa5mm) starts at $50,000 for 12 months, and our[MindFort vs XBOW](https://www.mindfort.ai/compare/mindfort-vs-xbow) comparison goes deeper.


### 3. What is Pentera best for?


Pentera validates security controls across networks, Active Directory, and cloud. Its[trust center ↗](https://trust.pentera.io/) lists an ISO 27001 certificate and EU hosting for Pentera Surface. Its[AI web app pentesting ↗](https://pentera.io/press-release/pentera-ai-web-app-pentesting/) is still in beta for selected customers. Its[AWS Marketplace listing ↗](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-56i5cowyjxcxm) is $120,000 for 12 months, and our[MindFort vs Pentera](https://www.mindfort.ai/compare/mindfort-vs-pentera) comparison goes deeper.


### 4. What is Horizon3.ai NodeZero best for?


NodeZero runs autonomous pentests against networks, Active Directory, and cloud. Horizon3.ai[opened its EMEA headquarters in Amsterdam ↗](https://horizon3.ai/news/press-release/horizon3-ai-opens-emea-headquarters-amsterdam/) in June 2026. Its[EU NodeZero deployment runs in Germany ↗](https://horizon3.ai/news/press-release/horizon3-earns-cyber-essentials-certification-covering-nodezero-eu-network/) .[AWS Marketplace pricing ↗](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-l4tou5vhpvarm) starts at $25,000 a year for 500 assets, and our[MindFort vs Horizon3.ai](https://www.mindfort.ai/compare/mindfort-vs-horizon3) comparison goes deeper.


### 5. What is Hadrian best for?


Hadrian is an Amsterdam company that uses AI agents to map and attack your internet-facing assets. It[raised $40M in October 2026 ↗](https://thenextweb.com/news/amsterdams-hadrian-raises-40m-for-ai-powered-offensive-security) , and its customers include TotalEnergies and Amadeus. Its Nova product runs automated pentests on demand, while Atlas maps your attack surface. Pricing requires a demo.


### 6. What is RunSybil best for?


RunSybil's agent[tests web and API attack surfaces ↗](https://www.runsybil.com/platform) in black-box, grey-box, or white-box mode. It[raised $40M led by Khosla Ventures ↗](https://www.runsybil.com/post/runsybil-raises-40m-to-build-the-ai-native-platform-for-offensive-security) in March 2026. Its[trust center ↗](https://trust.runsybil.com/) lists SOC 2 Type 2 and no hosting region. We found no EU presence, and our[MindFort vs RunSybil](https://www.mindfort.ai/compare/mindfort-vs-runsybil) comparison goes deeper.


### 7. What is PentAGI best for?


[PentAGI ↗](https://github.com/vxcontrol/pentagi) is a free, MIT-licensed multi-agent system that you host yourself. It runs tools like nmap, Metasploit, and sqlmap inside an isolated Docker sandbox. It can use local models, so test data can stay on your own servers in the EU. You run and patch it yourself with community support only.


## How do AI tools compare with Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity and DEFION?


The two best-known Dutch pentest companies have both changed names, and one now runs its own AI agent. They fit one-off needs like a TIBER-NL test or a pre-launch test. DEFION says a traditional application pentest[typically costs €10,000 to €20,000 ↗](https://defion.security/en/news/defion-pentest-agent-leiderschapswissel-2026/) .


### What does Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity offer?


Secura became[Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity ↗](https://group.bureauveritas.com/newsroom/launch-bureau-veritas-cybersecurity) in July 2025, with more than 300 experts worldwide. Pricing is quoted per engagement.


### What does DEFION offer?


Computest merged with Spain's Incide and[launched as DEFION ↗](https://defion.security/en/news/defion-launch-2025/) in September 2025. In July 2026, it launched a[Pentest Agent ↗](https://defion.security/en/news/defion-pentest-agent-leiderschapswissel-2026/) that does about 80% of the work, with a human ethical hacker validating findings. It can process data in the EU through Amazon Bedrock. DEFION is the clearest Dutch example of a hybrid between human and AI testing.


## How should a Dutch company choose an AI pentest tool?


Start with what you need to test and how often. Then check each vendor against this list:


- **Scope:** web apps, APIs, internal networks, cloud, or source code
- **Proof:** a working exploit for every finding
- **Fixes:** patch pull requests and automatic retests
- **Evidence:** reports and an attestation letter for Cbw supervisors, DNB, and auditors
- **Data residency:** where test data and LLM calls go
- **Cost:** a monthly price you can compare with a per-engagement quote

## FAQ


### Does the Cyberbeveiligingswet require a pentest?


Not explicitly. The Cyberbeveiligingsbesluit requires entities to evaluate the effectiveness of their security measures periodically. For digital providers, EU rules require a security testing policy based on risk. A pentest is the most common way to show that evidence.


### What does a pentest cost in the Netherlands?


DEFION says a traditional application pentest typically costs between €10,000 and €20,000. AI tools are priced as ongoing coverage instead. MindFort starts at $199 per month. Horizon3.ai starts at $25,000 per year on AWS Marketplace.


### How often does DORA require penetration testing?


DORA requires financial entities to test ICT systems that support critical functions at least once a year. Designated entities must also run threat-led penetration testing at least every three years. In the Netherlands, DNB runs this through TIBER-NL.
